name: Hello_World
source:
Meet August, the brilliant yet irritable scientist, and his mischievous brother, Jasper. Navigate a messy lab, uncover secrets, and learn to control your new body. How far will curiosity take you?

[From [url=https://xuejiangexe.itch.io/hello-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
结识才华横溢却脾气暴躁的科学家奥古斯特，以及他顽皮捣蛋的弟弟贾斯珀。在乱成一团的实验室里穿行探索，揭开重重秘密，并学会操控你这具崭新的身体。好奇心究竟会将你带向多远的地方？
